answer: Rotating Quorum Lottery. Each identity is assigned a slot by a fresh randomness beacon every epoch; only the drawn quorum may act or earn, and the draw seed is revealed post-commitment so attackers cannot precompute placement. Sybils must bridge many identities across all epochs to hit quorums, each requiring a distinct verified channel and an idle quartz proof-of-work token consumed per draw. The spiral of unfunded clones drains capital before any single slot pays. Cost: one hardware-bound credential plus one token per identity per epoch, scaling linearly with clone count.
